title: The guard run on a long command stays under the hook timeout
why: A long command makes the guard run pass the 20 s hook timeout, so the guard may not judge it at all.
source: coordinator 11:34 CST Nov 12, from lane tier-boundaries-carry's measure
note: Measure (lane tier-boundaries-carry, main 2deb827ad): the whole guard run on a plain 6000-word echo takes 21-24 s with TMPDIR unset (6.5 s at 3000 words), and 1.7-2.2 s with TMPDIR set. The hook timeout is 20 s. Cause not yet named. Lane guard-run-slow-long-command started 11:34 CST.
